notes: STRUCTURE: the 2026 Baltimore Ravens guide has no records/leaders section (its table of contents on p4 lists none; the guide's own note says records are on nfl.omgsports.com). The only ranked franchise lists are in the 'RAVENS DEFENSIVE RECORDS' sidebar on p363 (career tackles top 5, career INTs top 3, fumbles recovered top 3); those two are real lists. A quick grep of the 2025 and 2024 Ravens guide text dumps in ROOT/ia finds no records headings either (not read in detail).

PROSE ROWS: 14 other pairs are filled with 1-3 row lists built from sentences that state a franchise record or leader (bios, legend pages, history notes). I read each sentence on the page image at 200 dpi (the IA OCR text misreads some digits, e.g. 18 as 16 in Henry's bio). Each scope_note starts 'PROSE STATEMENT, NOT A RANKED LIST'; complete_to is the number of rows the guide gives, so rows 2..5 of the true top-5 are not available. Drop these rows if only real lists are wanted.

AS-OF: prose records are as of the season in which the sentence was written (stated in each scope_note). Examples of stale prose that were NOT used: p347 Todd Heap 'all-time leader in receiving TDs (41)' (superseded: Andrews 56), p352 Jackson 'franchise-record 36 passing scores' in 2019 (superseded by 41 in 2024), p345 Jamal Lewis 'all-time leading rusher' (no number).
through_season 2025: the guide includes 2025 stats (Henry 2025 entry with the 1/4/26 game at Pittsburgh, Andrews 2025 entry, 2025 game summaries and statistics pp301-330).

Mark Andrews's 'years' are 2018-25 inferred from his bio (drafted 2018, 2025 season shown). Printed totals 484/5,952/56 are labelled 'franchise leader' as of the end of 2025. Season receiving-TD top 3 combines two printed sentences (p99 and p100).
Not usable as Ravens franchise records: Ed Reed's NFL-wide interception-return lists (p364-365), Ray Lewis/Ed Reed 'NFL players' comparison tables, and opponent-record lines.
